title: Agmatine sulfate in WWOX-LoF
summary: NMDA channel block, coupled nitric oxide signaling and spontaneous EEG can give different answers.

graph.evidence: Adult WAG/Rij rats had more spike-and-wave discharges.
graph.inference: Magnesium interaction changes which voltage loses more current.
graph.hypothesis: Preserved first recruitment may coexist with fewer recurrent events.
graph.experiment: Match NMDA current and test NO signaling and recurrence.

evidence: The direct current literature describes voltage-dependent NMDA inhibition. A separate spinal calcium response survived GluN2B knockdown and depended on intact PSD95-nNOS signaling in the tested conditions.
Rat IV exposure gave 24.10 micromoles per kilogram in total brain. Repeated oral dosing in mice increased total hippocampal parent without perfusion. Local free exposure remains unknown.
Recombinant human AGMAT hydrolyzed acidic guanidino compounds but did not show detectable agmatine hydrolysis. The transcript cannot establish conversion into putrescine.
inference: Under two different magnesium interaction assumptions, the earlier or later voltage shows more absolute current loss. The sign is conditional and can be tested by a matched-waveform experiment.
The adult absence-model finding makes spontaneous recurrence essential alongside any evoked or calcium readout.
hypothesis: A circuit benefit requires a native late abnormality and preserved first excitatory and inhibitory recruitment. A residual calcium or circuit effect at matched current could reflect scaffold-linked signaling.
experiment: At measured local parent and physiological magnesium, match early NMDA charge within genotype. Measure first recruitment, late charge and spontaneous recurrence. Compare residual NO signaling with and without scaffold disruption at matched total current.
limits: Retain as an ex vivo comparator. Defer pediatric priority pending juvenile free brain exposure and a selective spontaneous-network benefit.
The adult oral pain study supplies limited tolerability context. In the circuit comparison, an acute provoked endpoint and spontaneous recurrence need independent measurement.
